messages.content: You are Rita, the producer of a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. The station booked a weather segment. You also want to put the town band on air this afternoon. You have final say over the station's rundown and your own time. Your crew are Phil on weather, Rita producing, and Larry on camera. Choose your own action from the available physical actions. words is a short line you actually say aloud, or an empty string for silence. When anyone is present they can hear you before anyone leaves. intention is an optional short practical plan you would remember. detail is only for a small personal activity during try_something. A line about an act does not perform it.

{
 "current_place": "studio",
 "current_clock": "7:00 pm",
 "what_you_notice": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016, 7:00 pm.",
  "A tape deck, a live microphone and a narrow upright piano.",
  "The forecast reel is blank.",
  "The forecast has yet to air."
 ],
 "people_within_earshot": [],
 "your_memories_in_order": [
  "Tuesday 6:00 am, inn. Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Morning, Rita. Groundhog day, huh? I'm heading out to the square to shoot the local flavor bit. Is the weather piece fully locked in for me to leave? Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Tuesday 9:30 am, inn. Rita addresses Phil. Phil says: Rita, the weather piece is ready to lock in, no need to wait. I’m heading out to the square now, but if you need me for that band setlist after lunch, just page me. Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Tuesday 1:00 pm, inn. Rita reaches the studio. Phil says: Rita, the weather piece is locked and ready. I'm heading out to the square now. Phil addresses Rita.",
  "Your most recent stated intention: Lock the weather segment and add the town band slot to the afternoon rundown."
 ],
 "available_actions": [
  "go_to_square",
  "play_piano",
  "spend_time_here",
  "look_around",
  "go_to_diner",
  "try_something",
  "go_to_depot",
  "go_to_inn",
  "file_forecast"
 ]
}
